parallelism: xargs -P 5 (all 5 surfaces concurrent; cli_validate was re-run alone after first attempt filled disk)
asan_note: ASan/UBSan requested by Invariant 26 but unavailable in this Python 3.11 build (libFuzzer prints 'Failed to find function __sanitizer_acquire_crash_state'). Documented as pre-existing constraint from T2; reachability coverage still exercised via 570M total iterations across 5 surfaces.
infrastructure_notes: Container disk filled to 100% during initial cli_parse/cli_decode/cli_validate runs because cmd_*'s print() handlers emit per-iteration Error: lines (~150-300 bytes each). At 700k exec/s this is ~150MB/s of stderr output. Mitigation: wrap harness invocation with `python3 -c "import sys, os; sys.stderr = open(os.devnull, 'w'); exec(open('harness_X.py').read())"` — Atheris's libFuzzer progress lines bypass Python sys.stderr (they go directly to fd 2 via libc), so iteration counts and pulse lines remain visible. cli_validate additionally needed stdout redirect because cmd_validate emits JSON to stdout. Iter rate dropped from 700k/s to 210k/s for cli_validate due to extra Python-level redirect overhead.
